name: CA-01
label: Safe D

key_factors: Polymarket prices a Democratic win near 95%
Mike McGuire has outraised incumbent Gallagher and benefits from outside spending
Gallagher's incumbency is the main offsetting factor
model.rationale: The redrawn CA-01 sits well left of its old configuration, and McGuire's fundraising edge plus outside support reinforce the district's Democratic lean. Gallagher's incumbency keeps the race from being a blowout, but nothing in the evidence points to a genuine contest.
model.watch: Any polling showing Gallagher consolidating the district's rural Republican base could narrow the margin.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; fundamentals point clearly one way (post-redistricting), so it is treated as safe for that party.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
California's first district was redrawn to lean Democratic, and state Senator Mike McGuire enters the general election with a fundraising advantage over incumbent Assemblymember-turned-congressman James Gallagher. McGuire has raised more money and drawn outside support, while Gallagher carries the benefit of incumbency in a seat with a strong rural Republican base.

Prediction markets price a Democratic win near 95%, and the district's partisan lean points the same direction. The forecast expects McGuire to win by a comfortable double-digit margin, with incumbency and the district's conservative pockets keeping the race from being entirely one-sided.
